contract.nativeComputation: Original endpoints retain coordinate and token; interior exactly start+(end-start)*(i/(n-1)) with separate binary64 operations. contract.bridgeWitness: Accessor-safe exact JSON request capture, complete original/final native model expectation, strict representability success admission, ordered intent/path receipt and immutable nonnumeric token inventory with canonical net numeric leaves. No YAML/Node/DOM product import.
contract.proposal: Private seventh WeakSet brand kind scene3d-distribution. Exact source5fields, complete source-order selected before/afterObjects, captured pre-await bytes and revisions, bare lowercase digest, native recomputation; serialized copies and six other author brands rejected. Host independently rechecks live ownership/approval after await.

limitations: Stage source tests only; actual checkout application remains separately reviewed.
The bridge recomputes binary64 values as response defense; Rust alone mutates author source.
No installed desktop/mobile device, hardware GPU, geometric AABB/size distribution, renderer selection or backend permission claim.
